title: 5/31 Stop Elon Musk Rally!
description:
### Join Indivisible Greater Vancouver (IGV) and MoveOn-Clark County for a peaceful protest at Vancouver's Tesla dealership!
Protests at Tesla dealerships all over the country have had a huge impact on Elon Musk's company - and we've been part of it! Musk may have stepped back from DOGE, but his operatives are still wreaking havoc through the federal government. Our rallies continue to raise awareness and educate the community.

We'll march on the sidewalk/right of way outside Vancouver's Tesla showroom on Fourth Plain Blvd., staying on public property. Park on the street or in the surrounding neighborhood. Bring a large sign to let everyone know we stand united against Musk, DOGE, and unelected oligarchs!

### JUNE TIME CHANGES
Starting June 1, we will no longer be rallying on Wednesdays. On Saturdays we'll rally at Tesla from 12noon-2pm.

We at IGV strongly believe that peaceful, non-violent activism offers social movements the most power to effect change. Through peaceful protests, we set an example of making our voices heard with dignity, empowered by truth. IGV does not condone intimidation, threats, vandalism, interference with access to a business, or any other lawless actions. If instigators or our opponents attempt to violate our commitment to non-violence, we will try to de-escalate them and will end the event if needed to maintain a safe environment.

Atlantic County Indivisible

**When:**  
**Tuesday, April 29 2025 — 4:30 PM**  
(Repeats every other Tuesday)

**Where:**  
**Jeff Van Drew’s District Office** 

Northfield Office

1001 Tilton Road
Suite 101
Northfield, NJ 08225
Phone: (609) 625-5008

**Event Description:**  
Congressman Jeff Van Drew is supposed to represent **us**—but he only meets with **donors**, **special interests**, and **MAGA extremists**.

He hasn’t held a public town hall in years, and his voting record speaks for itself:
- **Voted against certifying the 2020 election results**
- Opposed **abortion rights**, **student loan forgiveness**, and **LGBTQ+ protections**
- Supports efforts to **defund public education** and deny the climate crisis
- Turns his back on working people and silences dissent in our district

So we show up. Peacefully. Persistently. Every other Tuesday.

> **Donors get the meetings. Constituents get ignored.**

We’re rallying outside his **Northfield District Office** to demand visibility, accountability, and representation. This is a **peaceful protest** to let our neighbors—and our congressman—know we are watching.

**What to Bring:**
- Signs (or use ours!)  
- Friends, neighbors, coworkers  
- Water, weather-appropriate clothing  
- Your voice and your presence  

**Accessibility:**  
- Public sidewalk with parking nearby  
- No marching—stand or sit as long as you’d like

We’ve coordinated with local police to ensure a safe, orderly, nonviolent demonstration. Everyone who believes in democracy is welcome.

title: Tesla Takedown Protest in Seaside, Ca
description:
Join us EVERY Saturday at 12pm to protest Elon Musk and his unconstitutional dismantling of the federal government. Bring a sign, your friends, musical instruments, whatever makes you happy.

They've caused immense harm by dismantling USAID and have set their sights on everything from Social Security to the NIH and FAA next. Make no mistake, their end goal is the destruction of the US Federal Government and its ability to check corporate power and provide basic services.

How this develops in Washington remains to be seen, but as US citizens we can exercise our 1st Amendment right to peacefully protest. Elon Musk's access to money is largely based on Tesla stock, which is currently valued at 15-20 times that of other car companies. Driving down the share price is a direct attack on Elon's power.

The stakes couldn’t be higher. No one is coming to save us—not politicians, not the media. It's up to the people to stand up and fight for democracy and against fascism.

Let me reiterate, this is meant to be a peaceful protest and we cannot legally obstruct Tesla business or block the driveways. I would also ask that you not harass Tesla owners that come into the dealership as that's counter productive and antagonizes people who probably bought their cars before these events took place.

title: We Want Transit for All PA! 🚌❤️✊ Rally & Lobby Day

location.venue: PA Capitol Building, East Wing Fountain

description:
# Transit for All PA! Rally and Lobby Day in Harrisburg!

***Registration for transportation and lunch support is now closed. If you can transport yourself to Harrisburg and provide your own lunch, you are still welcome to RSVP to join us!***

Whether we live in big cities or small towns, public transit is a lifeline--it connects us to jobs, healthcare, community, and so much more. Public transit in Pennsylvania is under dire threat, but we can take action together to save and expand it.

**Join Transit for All PA! for a day of rallying and meeting with state legislators to share our stories and tell them: Pennsylvania deserves transit that moves all of us!**

- before 10am: Travel to Harrisburg
- 10am-11am: Rally & Press Conference
- 11am-3pm: Legislative Visits
- 11:30am-2:00pm: Boxed lunches available

## Transportation
**Registration for transportation support is now closed.** Anyone who registers after 5pm on Wednesday, May 28th is responsible for transporting themselves to and from Harrisburg. Anyone who registered before that time will be contacted by an organizer with more details.

### Transportation from Pittsburgh
**Registration for transportation support is now closed.** For those who registered before 5pm on Wednesday, 5/28: Buses to and from Harrisburg will be provided to attendees from Pittsburgh. Please meet at 4836 Ellsworth at 5:00 AM; the bus will depart at 5:30 AM. Stay tuned after registration for more details on how to reserve a spot on the bus.

### Transportation from Philadelphia
**Registration for transportation support is now closed.** For those who registered before 5pm on Wednesday, 5/28: Transit for All PA! will provide train tickets for attendees from the Philadelphia area. We will be taking the Keystone Line from the William H. Gray 30th Street. The train departs at 7:25 AM, so be sure to be there with plenty of time to board. Please stay tuned after registration for more details on how to reserve a ticket.

### Transportation from Lancaster
**Registration for transportation support is now closed.** For those who registered before 5pm on Wednesday, 5/28: Transit for All PA! will provide train tickets for attendees from the Lancaster area. The Keystone Line will arrive at the Lancaster Amtrak station at 8:42 AM, so be sure to be there with plenty of time to board. Please stay tuned after registration for more details on how to reserve a ticket.


### Transportation from other communities
**Registration for transportation support is now closed.** For those who registered before 5pm on Wednesday, 5/28: Transit for All PA! may also provide transportation from other communities in PA. We will determine which communities to charter buses to and from based on interest and funding, so please indicate if you would like transportation assistance when you fill out the form. Please stay tuned after registration for more details on how to reserve a spot.

## Food
**Registration for free lunch is now closed. Anyone who registers after 5pm on Wednesday, May 28th will need to provide their own lunch.** Anyone who registered before that point will receive a free lunch.

## Accessibility
Please let us know when you register if you have any additional access needs (I.e., mobility devices, interpretation, etc) that must be accommodated, either during the rally or during transportation to and from Harrisburg. If you have accessibility needs that are not listed on the form, please reach out to info@transitforallpa.org.

title: Northern Vermont Stands Up for Democracy!
description: Can you hear it? The voice of WE THE PEOPLE is growing. Around the country people are waking up, showing up, and joining up with their neighbors to rally to protect our Democracy, our Constitution, and our rule of law. The energy of the Hands Off! rallies is now spreading from city centers to other Vermont small towns. Beginning May 3rd, join your friends and neighbors right in your community. (St. Albans will gather at Taylor Park, Enosburg will gather at the Lincoln Park sidewalk along Main Street, Fairfax will gather at the Fairfax Community Corner Park, Milton will gather on RT 7 in front of Hannafords) Put your own community on this list as well by encouraging your friends and family to come out in your town to Stand Up for Democracy! Bring your best signs, flags, and energy! These will always be family-friendly peaceful demonstrations. Organized jointly by Green Mountain Alliance Indivisible, Rail City Indivisible, Cold Hollow Indivisible, and Franklin County Vermont Women for Democracy.

title: Worthington Rush Hour Rally
description:
Concerned about proposed cuts to Social Security services? Appalled by the abduction and renditioning of legal immigrants? Outraged by the theft of our private information? Generally dumbfounded by the chaotic combination of evil and incompetence coming from the White House? Make up a sign and let people know!

Thousands of cars pass through this intersection during rush hour every weekday. And the intersection is surrounded by the public Village Green Park on all four sides, giving us lots of room to hold signs protesting the ongoing destruction of our democracy by the Trump/DOGE administration.

Organized by the Worthington Area Democratic Club and Westerville Progressive Alliance.

Parking: On-street parking is limited around this intersection, but there is plenty of public parking nearby. Use the municipal lot on the east side of High Street south of the Village Green, or the municipal lot west of High Street (enter off New England Ave.). Other parking is available behind the Worthington Library and Kilbourne Middle School (enter both lots off Hartford St.). Lots for the Worthington Presbyterian Church (at the northwest corner of the Village Green) and the Worthington United Methodist Church (on the east side of High St. south of Short St.) are also options.

title: Rally to Support Healthcare for All Oregon!
description:
We're invited to Rally with many other local organizations working towards single-payer healthcare, including Oregon Working Families Party, Portland Jobs With Justice, Bernie PDX, Mid-Valley Health Care Advocates, Nurses For Single Payer, and PNHP Oregon.

Healthcare for All recognizes health care as a human right.
The ultimate goal is the elimination of private health insurance and the banning of for-profit delivery of care.  And enactment of a publicly financed, national single payer system that would provide comprehensive coverage to everyone.

This is a National Day of Action - we're invited to come together from our neighborhoods, unions, faith groups, businesses, and all types of civic organizations to join the demand to remove profit from health care. We're focusing our collective anger towards corporate health insurers to bring real reform: put National Single Payer on the nation’s agenda!
Find out more about Healthcare for All https://www.hcao.org/

title: No Kings Nationwide Day of Defiance with Indivisible Oregon and it's Partners
description:
On June 14th—Flag Day—Trump is staging a $50 million military parade in D.C., complete with tanks, warplanes, and thousands of troops. While MAGA shows off raw power, they’re slashing Medicaid, food assistance, and other life-saving services. It’s a spectacle meant to intimidate—but we won’t be silent.

Join local Indivisible groups in Portland for NO KINGS—a national day of defiance against authoritarianism and far-right extremism.

We’ll rally at Salmon Street Springs in Portland with music, performers, and powerful voices. From civil rights to antiwar movements, music has always fueled resistance and brought communities together in protest. After the rally, we’ll take that spirit and join the marchers as they leave the waterfront.

This is a peaceful, nonviolent protest—one rooted in hope, solidarity, and the power of collective action.

NO KINGS IN AMERICA.

title: NO KINGS, but YAAAAS Queen! - Boston Pride
description:
June 14th has been called as the next 50501 and Indivisible National Day of Action. This is Trump’s birthday and it is also the date of Boston Pride. Mass 50501 and Indivisible Mass Coalition are proud sponsors for Boston Pride 2025!

[Mass 50501](http://mass50501.org) and [Indivisible Mass Coalition](https://indivisible-ma.org) invite other aligned orgs to help amplify Pride by encouraging all groups to sign up to march and individuals to attend. We will not stand idly by while our queer and transgender brothers, sisters and nonbinary siblings are erased by this administration. 

View our [No Kings but Yaaas Queen](https://static1.squarespace.com/static/67b92dea290f26083f192486/t/682c946dc7bb0934aa7541f0/1747752045622/Digital_Flyer.png) and [No Kings but Drag Kings](https://static1.squarespace.com/static/67b92dea290f26083f192486/t/682ec13a703be162c75839f4/1747894586737/Digital+Flyer_king.png) flyers!

We will uplift the LGBTQIA+ community through solidarity during the joyful act of resistance that Pride has and always will stand for!!

The parade will last from approximately 11am-1pm. The festival in the Common will run from 12pm-3pm. Check out the official [Boston Pride website](http://bostonprideforthepeople.org) for more specific information and timing of events. If you would like to volunteer directly with Boston Pride for the People, please click [here](https://bostonprideforthepeople.volunteerlocal.com/volunteer/?id=96392).

Bring your friends and your flags and let this be the biggest Boston Pride EVER!!

title: Victory Red Day
description:
A campaign for a Day of Female Solidarity and Empowerment on June 24, 2025—the anniversary of Roe v. Wade’s repeal. The idea is simple yet powerful: women and supporters of women everywhere wear red lipstick as a symbol of strength, resilience, and the ongoing fight for gender equality.

Victory Red lipstick has long been a symbol of women’s power, particularly during World War II, when it was worn by women on the home front to represent strength, defiance, and patriotism. During this time, women stepped into roles previously held by men, contributing to the war effort while asserting their independence and resilience. They stood against facism, all while maintaining households and duties outside of their normal realm.

title: 50501 NO KINGS MONTEREY
description:
🇺🇸 NO KINGS: A Flag Day Rebellion for Democracy 🇺🇸

In America, we don’t bow to kings. We don’t crown rulers. And we don’t let symbols of freedom become props for power.

This country began with a rebellion against a king. The Revolutionary War was fought to throw off inherited power, unaccountable rule, and the idea that any one man had a divine right to govern others. That spirit—no thrones, no crowns, no kings—is the foundation of our democracy.

On Saturday, June 14—Flag Day—we gather across the country for NO KINGS, a national day of peaceful action. Together, we’re rising up against authoritarianism, corruption, and the growing threats to the freedoms generations have fought to protect.

While the clowniest wannabe oligarch ever throws himself an obscenely expensive military parade in our nation’s capital—surrounded by spectacle, sycophants, and billionaires—WE THE PEOPLE will be highly visible—UNITED as one, demanding that the Constitution be upheld, the scourge REMOVED, the damage REVERSED, and OUR DEMOCRACY RECLAIMED.

We’ve seen what happens when ego replaces leadership, when cruelty is mistaken for strength, and when power is hoarded instead of shared. Enough is enough.

We’re responding with ridicule and humor. Joyful resistance that reflects the absurdity of this political moment and reclaims our country.

Our flag doesn’t belong to strongmen, parties, or movements. It belongs to us—the people. Just like it always has.

🚩 Bring your FLAGS—lots of flags. Big ones, messy ones, handmade ones. Let’s flood the public squares with what freedom really looks like. Your flag is your voice—let it fly. 🚩

#NoKings #50501Monterey #BigTentResistance #KickOutTheClowns #GreatestShitshowOnEarth 

The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump and his MAGA minions. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.

title: Wednesday Movement Sign Wave in Lauraville (Rain or Shine)
description:
The Wednesday Movement launched on March 12, 2025 when disgruntled seniors took to the streets in Baltimore to make their feelings known. The Movement, a weekly Pro-Democracy, Anti-Trump, Anti-Putin vigil, gathers on a heavily trafficked Baltimore street corner on Wednesday evenings.

We invite others who feel the same way to join the Movement. You do not need to be old, you do not need to be in Baltimore, and you do not need to stand on Wednesdays, but we ask that you use the Wednesday Movement banner.

It’s easy:​ Reach out to friends and neighbors​. Make some signs (one should say “We Are The Wednesday Movement)​. Pick a day, time, and location that works for your group. And spread the word!  This is a grassroots initiative. It has the potential to change the world. Join with us and help make it happen!

The Lauraville Sign Wave will be held Rain (definitely in a drizzle but maybe not in a downpour and definitely not with thunder/lightning in the forecast) or Shine.

Contact Anne George, 443-831-7528 for more information on initiating a sign wave in your area.

title: "Moral Monday" Street Rally

address_lines: N. Main St. and W. Division St.

description:
Please join us in opposing cuts to essential safety net programs!

Please join us at weekly recurring  "Moral Monday" street rallies, alternating between Hudson WI and River Falls WI.

Our first “Moral Monday” street rally will be in Downtown Hudson on Monday May 5, from 4PM to 6PM, at the intersection of Second and Vine Streets, where we will hold signs and stand along the public sidewalks.

Our second “Moral Monday” street rally will be in River Falls on Monday May 12, from 4PM to 6PM, at the intersection of Main and Division Streets, where we will hold signs and stand along the public sidewalks.

Folks may join for part or all the two hours, and may bring their own signs or use signs we’ll have to share.

If the weather is bad—hard rain, high wind, and/or lightening—we’ll cancel that week’s rally.

Our "Moral Monday" street rallies are inspired and informed by work of the prominent North Carolina pastor and anti-poverty activist the Rev. William Barber, who founded the Center for Public Theology and Public Policy at Yale and now teaches there.

On the twelfth anniversary of his first "Moral Monday" demonstration, Monday April 28, 2025, Rev. Barber was arrested for praying against the Republican-led budget while in the Rotunda of our US Capitol. At a rally held before he entered the Rotunda to pray, Rev. Barber said: “Forty-three percent of women and almost half of all children are poor and low income. Somebody ought to say something … Somebody gotta challenge this budget.”

We are holding "Moral Monday" street rallies to voice our challenges.

We oppose Republican-approved Congressional budget resolutions that harm the poorest and most vulnerable of Americans in order to give more than $5-trillion in tax breaks to the richest and most privileged of Americans.

We oppose Trump/Musk budget proposals that eliminate or make draconian cuts to federal programs for child care, health research, education, housing assistance, community development, and the elderly.

These funding cuts and proposed budgets are not just public policy choices, they are moral choices. 

These funding cuts and proposed budgets are morally wrong, not just bad public policy choices. 

Please join with us to "say something" and "challenge this budget".

We wish to remind everyone that we do not react to those drivers who make it clear they do not support us by aggravating them through screaming obscenities or making certain hand gestures. title: Protect The Constitution - Protest on The Norwalk Town Green
description:
Join us Saturday, May 31st, at 1 PM on the Historic Norwalk Green for a peaceful sign-waving protest to protect the Constitution! Our constitutional rights are under attack, and we need to keep the pressure up. Stand up! Fight back!

Hands off our rights! Hands off our people! Hands off free speech! Hands off LGBTQ+ rights! Hands off due process! Hands off union and workers! Hands off working families! Hands off Medicaid/Medicare! Hands off education! Hands off diversity, equity and inclusion! 

During this event, there will be a public reading of the Constitution by members of the public and invited speakers. Please RSVP for more information.

Come one hour early, at 12 pm, for a pre-protest picnic and community block party with the Good Trouble - Indivisible Norwalk Team!

Thanks!

TRANSPORTATION AND PARKING:

Parking near The Green is limited, so you may prefer to walk or take transit. If you can, consider public transit:

East Norwalk Metro North station is a 20-minute walk to the Town Green.

Norwalk Transit District runs frequent bus service from the Greater Norwalk area to Burnell Blvd, a short walk from the Town Green:

- From Flax Hill or Hospital Hill, take the WHEELs 9 on Fairfield Ave or 
   Stevens St.
- From East Norwalk, take the WHEELs 11 from Van Zant Street or East Ave,
   or the WHEELs 7 from Westport Ave or Strawberry Hill Ave.
- From Merritt 7 or Main Ave area, take the WHEELs 3 on Main Ave or 
  Glover Ave.
- From other parts of Norwalk, you can take Wheels2U 
  (https://www.wheels2u.org/) starting at 1 PM.


Parking: 

Please park at either:
Yankee Doodle Garage, Norwalk
or Norwalk City Hall

Both of these are a 10-15 minute walk to the Green.

Please only park on the side streets near the Town Green if you have an accessible parking permit! We're trying to keep the protest as inclusive as we can!

Please email goodtroublenorwalk@gmail.com for additional accessibility information.

title: FLAG DAY CELEBRATION - No Kings!
description:
On Flag Day, June 14, while some may focus on a costly and controversial military parade, Traverse Indivisible is inviting all members of the community to join a vibrant and inclusive protest and promenade at The Governmental Center, located at 400 Boardman Ave in Traverse City.

From Noon to 3 PM, this family-friendly celebration will honor the true spirit of Flag Day by bringing people together, fostering community, and providing a platform for voices to be heard.

Part promenade, part protest, this celebration offers a positive and engaging alternative to the reported $92 million military parade planned elsewhere. Instead of allowing a display of power to be the center of gravity, we want to make action everywhere else the story of America that day. This event is about celebrating in the face of adversity and building community.

Attendees are encouraged to bring their flags, signs, and even costumes to express their patriotism and commitment to democratic values. Whether marching in the promenade or enjoying the festivities, there will be ample opportunities for participation and community connection.

More Information:

This event is part of a larger nationwide movement where activists, alongside local organizers, partners, and leaders from across the pro-democracy and pro-worker movements, will unite for marches, rallies, and demonstrations to reject corrupt, authoritarian politics in the United States.

This demonstration is organized with a steadfast commitment to peace and non-violence. Participants are dedicated to upholding a safe and respectful environment, ensuring all activities remain within the bounds of lawful and peaceful assembly.

title: Protect NY's Climate Law - Syracuse
description:
Join Citizen Action of NY, PUSH Buffalo, NY Renews, Third Act Upstate New York, Indivisible Onondaga County, Cayuga Climate Action, Alliance for a Green Economy, and other local CNY groups to rally and testify at a DEC public hearing in Syracuse on June 3 at noon to defend NY’s Climate Law.

New Yorkers will join to voice their support for climate leadership and to urge Governor Hochul to stand up to Trump by funding climate legislation. Join us and help make this impactful by emailing egormley@citizenactionny.org.

The climate change-denier in the White House is doing everything he can to eliminate climate progress in this country. We need climate leadership in NY, and we need it now. Unfortunately, in January, Governor Hochul revealed that she’s delaying a crucial component of the state’s Climate Law called Cap and Invest. 


Cap and Invest is an emissions-reduction program that would limit, or cap, emissions from major polluters in the state. That cap would tighten over time, gradually reducing the amount of emissions allowed for release. Meanwhile, major polluters will have to pay to release polluting emissions up to the level of the cap. Those funds from polluters will then be used to invest in green energy, jobs, home decarbonization programs, and similar efforts to support NY communities.

To move Cap and Invest forward, we need the Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) to release three sets of regulations that hold polluters accountable to Cap and Invest. Unfortunately, Governor Hochul has  released only one.

title: Indivisible Pittsburgh says: "NO KINGS: Kick Out the Clowns!"
description:
Join INDIVISIBLE PITTSBURGH, B-PEP,  other regional Indivisible groups and community partners as we say: 
“NO Kings–Kick Out the Clowns!” 

Pittsburgh is a democracy town! We know that America is not a country of Kings but of neighbors, building  (I don’t understand this shoulder building) for the future! More than 6,000 Pittsburghers  joined Indivisible Pittsburgh in May to say Hands Off  our rights as Americans and Hands Off of our investments in our future. Join us again  to stand together to say that America is not a country of Kings, but a country of laws. Join us to say that competency matters and that supporting our neighbors is our intention and priority–NOT tax breaks for the wealthy!

For this "No Kings!" event, Indivisible Pittsburgh proudly partners with The Black Political Empowerment Project (B-PEP)  which has empowered African-Americans in their communities since 1986, other local and regional Indivisible groups, and other community organizations.  We will hear from speakers and more at Freedom Corner, just above downtown and then march down to the City-County Building on Grant Street for more speakers, letter writing, and more.   We will join to stand together against Trump, Musk, and Trumpism to say NO to kings, NO to the rich getting richer, NO to oligarchy and YES to Democracy and due process.  


WHAT IS “NO KINGS”?

NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to the increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption of the Trump administration. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political positions, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies. They think they rule—but we are bigger than even their worst aspirations.

Donald Trump is planning a military parade in Washington, D.C. on June 14. This display of might is intended to intimidate opponents and solidify his image as a strongman on our dime—we won’t stand by while that happens.

Instead of allowing this military parade to be the center of gravity, we will make action everywhere else the story of America that day: people coming together in communities across the country to reject strongman politics and corruption.

Alongside local organizers, partners, and leaders from across the pro-democracy & pro-worker movement across the nation, we will demonstrate organized people power that outpaces any authoritarian aspirations.


STATE OF PLAY: WHY WE’RE MOBILIZING JUNE 14 

Donald Trump thinks his rule is absolute, but in America, we don’t do “kings.” Since the inauguration, the Trump administration and its enablers have operated as though they have a mandate—but they don’t, and never did. They are going to extremes to empower Trump and enrich themselves, while cutting jobs and services for the rest of us. Now, they’re turning Flag Day into a celebration of Trump.

💰 He’s using OUR tax dollars to pay for HIS party: Donald Trump’s birthday celebration is expected to cost millions of our tax dollars, all while Republicans claim there’s no money for Social Security, SNAP, or Medicaid.

👑 We are united against kings: Trump has already indicated that he’s aiming for at least a third term, and now he’s planning a self-aggrandizing military parade in D.C But the American people don’t put up with kings. Together, we will mobilize in huge numbers to reject this corruption and abuse of power—it’s in our DNA as a country.

✋ They’ve gone too far: This is bigger than political disagreement. They’ve defied our courts, deported American citizens, disappeared people off the streets, and slashed our services—all while orchestrating a massive giveaway to their billionaire allies. Enough is enough. For anyone who thinks he’s gone too far, this movement is for you.

We’re standing together against the abuses of power, cruelty, and corruption. On June 14, we gather to remind Trump and his enablers: America has No King!

✅ Bring signs or props → Make your message visible! (Ideas: “NO KINGS IN AMERICA!”, “THE PEOPLE UNITED”, “NOT YOUR PIGGYBANK!”)
✅ Recruit friends → The more people, the more power.

accessibility_notes:
We have had many people with canes, walkers and wheelchairs on the bridge with us. Please join us

For bridge protests, where visibility from a distance is crucial, the larger the lettering, the better. Here are some key considerations and general guidelines:

**General Visibility Rules:**

* **Distance is Key:** The primary factor is how far away your audience will be. For highway overpasses, traffic might be moving quickly and at a significant distance.
* **"Rule of Thumb" for Legibility:** A common guideline for outdoor signage is that each inch of letter height provides approximately 10 feet of legibility. So, for every 100 feet of viewing distance, you'd want at least 10-inch tall letters.
* **Bridge Specifics:** Bridges often mean viewing from a greater distance than a sidewalk. Consider vehicles on the road below, and potentially other onlookers further away.

**Practical Recommendations for Bridge Protests:**

* **Go Big:** Aim for lettering that is at least **12-24 inches tall**, and even larger if possible. Some sources suggest using 20x30 or 24x30 inch boards for individual letters to create large, impactful messages.
* **Bold, Simple Fonts:** Choose block, sans-serif fonts (like Arial or Helvetica) that are thick and easy to read. Avoid thin, ornate, or script fonts.
* **High Contrast Colors:** This is critical!
    * **Dark letters on a light background** (e.g., black on white, dark blue on yellow) offer the best visibility.
    * **Avoid low-contrast combinations** like yellow on white or light blue on a pale background.
    * **Limit your color palette** to two or three colors for maximum impact and clarity.
* **Concise Messaging:** Shorter messages with fewer words are easier to read quickly from a distance. Each letter takes up space, so a long message will require smaller letters to fit, reducing visibility.
* **Material and Construction:**
    * **Sturdy materials:** Foam core boards or corrugated plastic are more rigid and durable than regular poster board, especially in windy conditions.
    * **Weatherproof:** Consider if rain or sun will affect your signs. Paint or vinyl letters are more resilient than marker.
    * **Double-sided signs:** If possible, make your signs double-sided to maximize visibility from different angles, especially for media coverage.
* **Test Your Signs:** Before the protest, hold up your signs and have someone view them from a distance similar to what you expect on the bridge. This will help you determine if the lettering is large enough and if the message is clear.
* **Spacing (Kerning):** Ensure there is adequate space between letters and words so they don't blend together from a distance.

By focusing on large, bold, high-contrast lettering and concise messages, you'll maximize the impact and readability of your bridge protest signs.

The City of Stonecrest is celebrating Juneteenth bigger than ever before this year by hosting it's 3rd annual Juneteenth Celebration of Freedom on Saturday June 14, 2025.

DeKalb Dems will have a visibility tent and we need volunteers to assist with set up and act as Ambassadors who listen to citizen's concerns, offer ways we can support them, and talk about what they can do to safeguard our freedom.

Juneteenth commemorates the effective end of slavery in the United States. Two years after President Lincoln signed the Emancipation Proclamation, news reached Texas and, upon learning they were free, former slaves immediately began celebrating with prayer, feasting, song, and dance. The Juneteenth Celebration of Freedom will celebrate African American culture, heritage, and, most importantly, abolishment of slavery.

The Juneteenth Celebration of Freedom will feature an expanded kidz zone, live performances, food trucks, vendors, and fireworks show. It is a place for all races, nationalities, and religions to join hands and truthfully acknowledge a period in history that shaped and continues to influence our society today, according to a news release. This event is free and open to the public, and we encourage everyone to attend and learn more about the history and culture of Juneteenth!

Please sign up for a shift below and be a part of this Celebration of Freedom.

title: No Kings Day Mobilization - SAVE THE DATE
description:
WHAT IS “NO KINGS”?

NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to the increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption of the Trump administration. 

- We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political positions, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies. They think they rule—but we are bigger than even their worst aspirations.

- Donald Trump is planning a military parade in Washington, D.C. on June 14. This display of might is intended to intimidate opponents and solidify his image as a strongman on our dime—we won’t stand by while that happens.

- Instead of allowing this military parade to be the center of gravity, we will make action everywhere else the story of America that day: people coming together in communities across the country to reject strongman politics and corruption.

- Alongside local organizers, partners, and leaders from across the pro-democracy & pro-worker movement, we will demonstrate organized people power that outpaces any authoritarian aspirations.

* NO KINGS events should be additive and congruent with adjacent mobilizations and recognitions, including Veterans celebrations, Pride events, and Juneteenth on 6/19.

title: NO KINGS Raleigh
description:
This June 14th, stand with us at the steps of the North Carolina State Capitol for No Kings Day—a nonpartisan, peaceful rally in defense of the American principles we all hold dear: democracy, accountability, and the rule of law.

Across the political spectrum, more and more Americans are feeling disillusioned by leaders who put themselves above the people. This day is for anyone who believes that no one—no matter how powerful—should be treated like royalty in a nation built on liberty.

We’re gathering not in anger, but in unity. This is a space for reflection, connection, and a shared commitment to a country where leaders serve, not rule. Whether you're conservative, progressive, independent, or politically unsure—if you believe in the idea of a government by and for the people, this rally is for you.

This is a peaceful, de-escalation-focused event. There is no place here for violence, intimidation, or hate. We welcome calm, respectful voices who want to help shape a future rooted in mutual respect and civic responsibility.

Bring your signs, your friends, your conscience—and your belief that the United States was never meant to have kings.

title: No Kings On D-Day
description:
# On June 6th, 2025, the Anniversary of D-Day, Mass 50501 will hold an event in remembrance of our heroes in uniform, past and present.

Our mission is the preservation of the democracy that they fought—and in some cases died—to protect on the shores of Europe. We will feature speakers who are themselves veterans, who will speak on history, duty, honor, sacrifice, and patriotism. We will conduct a wreath-laying ceremony at the Soldiers and Sailors Monument on the Boston Common featuring patriotic renditions of “Taps,” “Battle Hymn of the Republic,” and other songs. We will protest cuts to the VA, oppose the undemocratic way in which the administration has treated its duties, reaffirm our support for our allies, and recommit ourselves to the principles that have governed the nation and its military for centuries, and we will remind the people that veterans and active duty military personnel exist to protect the nation against all enemies, foreign and domestic. It will be both a protest and a solemn event of remembrance. 

## Event Program

## Act 1: Invocation of Service
An honor guard procession will bear American, State, and Service flags from the Soldiers and Sailors Monument to the stage, followed by an invocation and remarks from the Program Director. 

## Act 2: The Citizen Soldier
We'll hear from ordinary citizens—veterans and those who support them—addressing the issues that matter to veterans today.

## Act 3: A Call to Duty
VIP speakers will offer stories to help draw us together, and remind us that the bonds of service do not end upon separation from the military and that participation in our democracy is essential to its health and prosperity.

## Act 4: Honor the Fallen
The honor guard and key speakers will process back to the Soldiers and Sailors Monument to lay a wreath, followed by Taps, a moment of silence, and closing words. 

# Flags are welcome, but please leave protest signs at home.

title: Kick Out the Clowns
description:
Placer Women Democrats are joining The Women's March for the June 14 Rally!

When you elect clowns, they don’t become leaders. The country becomes a circus. 🤡

On June 14, Donald Trump will honor himself with a four-mile military parade in our nation’s capitol. Trump’s tacky parade was inspired by dictators he idolizes, and will cost taxpayers nearly $100 million. 

Organizer and strategist Daniel Hunter has written that “Humor is important for our psyches — and to take fascists down a notch[…] Humor is key for morale and exposing the vulnerability of the strongman image.” This is where the ridiculous meets the resistance—and where the future is on the line.

June 14 is our chance to reflect the absurdity of the MAGA regime and the clowns who lead it. To meet this moment, Women’s March will host community circuses nationwide—bold, creative actions that mirror the chaos MAGA has sown across the country. Together, we’ll set a national record for the most circuses held in a single day while we simultaneously refuse to celebrate a petty clown who desperately wants to be seen as strong. We won’t stop until we build the country we all deserve.

title: #NoKings Day with Sister District Project SF
description:
Join your friends and neighbors at Sister District Project San Francisco for the #NoKings mass protest and day of defiance!

On June 14, rise up with millions across the country, on Tr*mp's planned military parade day, to stand in opposition and fight back against the attacks on our freedoms by this jury-determined rapist, twice-impeached, 34-time convicted felon, and January 6 traitor. 

Look for the Sister District San Francisco banner on sidewalk in front of Children's Day School (601 Dolores St), directly across from Dolores Park at corner of 19th St. We will meet there at 11am before the march down Market Street that heads to the main rally in front of City Hall. 

Bring signs, wear your SDP t-shirt and caps if you have them (we'll have a few extras). 

Together, let's demand a country that puts our families over billionaires' fortunes—public schools over private profits, healthcare over hedge funds, prosperity over the profits of price-gouging and climate polluting corporations.

_A core principle behind all #NoKings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values._

To learn more about this national day of action, visit [nokings.org](https://www.nokings.org/)

To learn more about Sister District Project, visit [SisterDistrict.com](https://sisterdistrict.com/strategy).

Since 2016, Sister District Project has been building enduring progressive power in the states to improve people's lives, including by supporting community-based organizations led by people of color on the ground, like [New Virginia Majority](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sd016-va-nvmef-sf), who do critical grassroots work year round.

You are welcome to join any of our monthly meetings, whichever is most convenient for you! 

We host events on **Zoom the first Tuesday** of each month; in-person **Happy Hours on the first Thursdays** of even-numbered months; in-person **Coffee Hours on first Thursdays** of odd-numbered months (locations vary); or in-person **Postcard events** on third Sundays or Mondays.

title: NO KINGS Newark DE

description:
Get ready for a big day of national protest on June 14th! A parking map is available at www.IndivisibleNewarkDE.org. Please be conscious of where you park, and leave closer spots for people who use a wheelchair, a walker, etc. 

We are coordinating a food drive at this protest to support the Delaware Food Bank! Look for the black pickup truck with the Food Bank signs right at S College and W Main!

title: Protest Avelo Airlines' Plan to Carry Out Deportation Flights - ONGOING
description:

title: Speak Out, Seniors! Stand Out/Sit Out for Democracy
description:
Join us for a Stand out/Sit out rally especially for seniors—but open to all ages—at Coolidge Corner! We’re speaking out against the abuses of the Trump administration. Let’s stand up for many things: immigrant rights and human rights; free speech, the Constitution and the rule of law; healthcare and social security; and the health of our planet. We stand for peace and an end to the devastating wars in Gaza and Ukraine. We stand up for democracy, justice, and the future we want to leave to the next generation.

This is a peaceful, spirited gathering—bring your voice, your friends, and your signs! Walkers, wheelchairs, scooters, and all mobility devices are welcome.

Suggestion:  bring a water bottle.

In case of bad weather, organizers may not be present—but anyone who wishes to come is, of course, welcome to do so.

Let’s show the world that seniors will not be silent!  Speak Out, Seniors! is growing and standing up for democracy, one rally at a time.  We will continue our weekly tradition for as long as it takes!
accessibility_notes:
Walkers, wheelchairs, scooters, and all mobility devices are welcome.  No additional seating available. 
Note:  please be mindful/careful of the traffic and the T trains. Stay on the sidewalk and off the tracks in Coolidge Corner.

title: Croton, NY: Pass a Resolution Against Project Maple
description:
**Join us outside the Croton Board of Trustees meeting to demand local action against Project Maple** — a dangerous fracked gas pipeline expansion plan that threatens our climate, our river, and our health.

Fossil Fuel company Enbridge's Project Maple would expand the amount of fracked gas running through the existing Algonquin Pipeline (which runs through Westchester County) by replacing existing pipe and expanding compressor stations. 

This project would lock us into decades of fossil fuel dependence — just when we need to be transitioning to clean energy. It’s risky, unnecessary, and completely out of step with New York’s climate goals. **Croton has the chance to be a climate leader by passing a resolution opposing this reckless project.**

Meet us outside Croton-on-Hudson Village Hall, where we’ll rally together, then head into the board meeting to make powerful public comments demanding the Village take a stand.

Let’s pack the room and show our elected officials that Croton stands for climate justice, not fossil fuel expansion. Bring your friends, your voice, and your passion — we’ll have talking points and signs ready to go!

The Visibility Brigade is hosting a NO KINGS action at our favorite Route 4 overpass in Paramus, New Jersey, to wave at cars below and remind them we are in a moment of crisis. Come join us by signing up for our Paramus group at www.VisibilityBrigade.com and typing NO KINGS in the "How did you find out about our group?" question.  

Once you've been added, we will let you know the more specific time frame that we'll be out on the overpass than what is included in this public-facing sign-up form. 

We will be supplying the large overpass letters for you to stand over and wave, but you should feel welcome to bring your own signs as well (just keep them PG please!)

The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.


**On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings.**
Check out nokings.org for more information.

accessibility_notes: This overpass is wheelchair accessible, with an elevator on the North side and a ramp on the south. Both sides of the overpass lead down to ample public parking.

title: This Is Our America – Visibility Event for No Kings Day
description:
A military parade on the leader’s birthday, is not America. Citizens gathering peacefully, is.

Trump’s military parade could cost as much as $45 million. In our America, we organize and gather for free because we love our country. 

Join us on June 14, nationwide “No Kings” Day of Action, for a peaceful, public demonstration of what we value as Americans: our country and all who call it home, and the rights and freedoms enshrined in the Constitution. 

Not a wanna-be dictator who uses Flag Day and the US Army’s 250th birthday as justification to throw himself a military parade at our expense.

title: NO KINGS Frisco, Texas

location.venue: FM 423 (both sides) between Main/King and Stonebrook

description:
June 14th is Flag Day and the 250th anniversary of the establishment of the United States Army. Coincidentally, it is also President Trump’s 79th birthday, and he is staging a $45 million military parade to appease his ever expanding ego! 

Who does that? Kings, tyrants, and dictators do.

In 1775, we began the fight for independence from the tyrant King George III of England. In 2025, we are reminding Trump and our elected representatives that America rejects his authoritarian actions, consolidation of power, disregard of law, and defiance of the courts. WE THE PEOPLE proclaim, once again: NO KINGS!  

We are joining millions of people all over the nation to rain on his taxpayer funded parade. We are reclaiming the flag and honoring those who have died protecting the democratic principles it represents. We are preserving our constitutional democracy. We are asserting the Army’s motto: THIS WE’LL DEFEND! 

NO KINGS is a national day of action that welcomes people from all walks of life to join in peaceful, joyful, nonviolent dissent. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.

WHAT TO BRING: a friend, water, US flags, signs that reflect our theme - no kings, Army motto, democracy, rule of law, etc.

WHAT TO WEAR: sunscreen, light-colored clothing and hat, patriotic colors, stars & stripes, Army shirts, camoflage, Revolutionary War costumes, etc.

SPECIAL REQUEST: I’m looking for people that could bring the painting “The Spirit of ’76” to life. For that, we need a piccolo player playing “Yankee Doodle” and/or “The Army Goes Rolling Along,” a snare drummer, and a flag bearer. I’m also looking for trumpeters to play “The Star-Spangled Banner” and/or some bugle calls. Please contact me if you can help with this!

title: NO KINGS MASS PROTEST: MARCH for DEMOCRACY
description:
Join 50501 and Show Me Action for a NO KINGS MASS PROTEST and MARCH for DEMOCRACY on June 14 from 2 PM to 5 PM. We will rally at Kiener Plaza in Downtown St. Louis.

Schedule:

- 2 PM:  Rally 

- 3 PM: March (Time subject to change) 
  
After the march, return to Kiener Plaza for community time to support recovery efforts in North St. Louis. More details on relief and recovery will be added closer to the date. 

Donald Trump thinks his rule is absolute, but in America, we don’t do “kings.” Since the inauguration, the Trump administration and its enablers have operated as though they have a mandate—but they don’t, and never did. They are going to extremes to empower Trump and enrich themselves, while cutting jobs and services for the rest of us. Now, they’re turning Flag Day into a celebration of Trump. 

We’re standing together against the abuses of power, cruelty, and corruption. On June 14, we gather to remind Trump and his enablers: America has No King!

Join millions nationwide on June 14 to march against authoritarian politics and billionaire takeover. Be part of a national moment that changes the conversation—and turns the tide.

Register to receive details and updates in the days leading up to the event.

title: EVERY SATURDAY in OMAK, WA 12-2PM
description:
BE EFFECTIVE: 
  EVERY SATURDAY let's SHOW UP at the light in Omak at 601 Omache Drive! Any amount of time you can be there 12-2PM can be EFFECTIVE in getting the eyes of our working community on us as they run errands in town, get groceries, and stop for gas on the way home.

BE CONSISTENT: 
  Let's mark our calendars for EVERY SATURDAY 12-2PM !!

BE LEGAL: 
  Please stay on public sidewalks. Do not block traffic. Cross the street using the crosswalks when the traffic light allows.

BE SAFE: 
  Here is some de-escalation training:

We choose our families over their fortunes!! This is about organizing for our future! The rich are getting richer while the rest of us can’t catch a break. This system was never built for us. But we’re building something better together! They are afraid of our solidarity because it works!

SHOW UP in nonviolent protest in defense and support of working people in Okanogan County and everywhere.

When do we want them? NOW and always because the United States is a democracy--it's not a monarchy, it's not an oligarchy, and it's not a dictatorship. It's not run by a king and his henchmen, it's *led* by *elected* individuals in service to the American people.

NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. title: Public Service Commission Candidate Open Forum
description:
As temperatures heat up and power bills rise, frustrated Georgians are starting to look at the Public Service Commission (PSC) for new regulations and to potentially bust up a Georgia Power monopoly.  Statewide PSC primaries for seats in Districts 2 and 3 will be held on June 17 and the general election will be on November 4.

Coastal Georgia for Democracy, the Savannah Indivisible group for Georgia District 1, will host a live open forum for voters to ask the candidates questions about their positions in advance of the election. The event will be held at the Coastal Georgia Center, 305 Fahm Street, Savannah, on June 12 at 6:00pm.  The free event is open to the public.

All PSC candidates have been invited to appear and will answer voters’ questions regarding anything under the purview of the Public Service Commission, which includes how much Georgia residents pay for their electricity, landline telephones, and natural gas.  They also oversee the 811 “Call before you dig” line and items related to line interruptions when they are improperly monitored by contractors and residents. 

Confirmed attendees for the candidate forum include Dr Alicia Johnson in District 2 and Daniel Blackman, Peter Hubbard, Robert Jones, and Keisha Sean Waites in District 3.
 
The Georgia Public Service Commission has exclusive power to decide what are fair and reasonable rates for services under its jurisdiction. They must balance Georgia citizens' need for reliable services and reasonable rates with the need for utilities to earn a reasonable return on investment while not guaranteeing it. The Commission protects consumers' interests while abiding by legal standards in setting rates. All matters scheduled for public hearing are heard by the Commissioners or in special cases, by an appointed hearing officer in open session.

Coastal Georgia for Democracy, a grassroots group of residents in the coastal Georgia region, is Savannah’s Indivisible group in Georgia’s District 1. We are committed to protecting democracy and promoting genuine equity and inclusion through progressive advocacy. We do not endorse candidates. We aim to defend and protect against attacks on constitutionally guaranteed freedoms, including safe and fair elections and the voting rights of citizens. To learn more, visit us at https://www.coastaldemocracy.org.

title: Pack City Hall for Safe Healthy Homes Act Hearing!
description:
Pack City Hall on Tuesday June 3rd to make sure the City Council protects renters and VOTES YES at the hearing on the Safe Healthy Homes Act!

When: Tuesday June 3rd at 1pm (come early to be ready!)

Where: City Hall 4th Floor

What: City Council Housing Committee hearing on June 3rd to vote on the Safe Healthy Homes Act, 3 bills that strengthen renters rights by giving the City the power to proactively inspect rental units, hold bad landlords accountable when they violate the code, and ensure protections for renters against retaliation.

Why: We have a housing safety crisis in our city.  Hundreds of renters are going without heat in winter or living with mold, leaks, infestations, lead, fire hazards, or other dangerous conditions that are affecting our health and even taking lives. We need City Council to PROTECT renters! We need YOU and every person who can make it to show up to make sure Council passes these bills.

JOIN US to show City Council that you want them to VOTE YES to protect renters! 

SIGN UP FOR PUBLIC COMMENT: https://forms.gle/VwtXVsMv5MoHbZV4A

We have a real chance to get this HUGE WIN for renters across the city. But the corporate landlord lobbyists will be out in force to block this legislation, so we need to outnumber them to show that the PEOPLE support renter protections. Can you give a 2-minute comment to City Council in support of the Safe Healthy Homes Act on June 3rd? Sign up at the link above.

title: No Kings-National Day of Action Rally
description:
On June 14, from 11:00am- 1:30pm we will gather at the intersection of US-1 & SR-520, Cocoa, FL to remind Trump and his enablers: America has No King!
🔘Please bring your own beverages & signs.
🔘There will be some signs, sign making materials & water provided.
🔘Feel free to dress in costumes.
🔘Music & street theater throughout gathering.
🔘This is a Peaceful gathering. Please ignore any distractors, use crosswalks, & stay on sidewalks. There will be safety people in vests on all 4 corners.

If you're able, please bring non-perishable food, blankets, socks, etc. to donate.⬅️‼️
Donald Trump thinks his rule is absolute, but in America, we don’t do “kings.” Since the inauguration, the Trump administration and its enablers have operated as though they have a mandate—but they don’t, and never did. They are going to extremes to empower Trump and enrich themselves, while cutting jobs and services for the rest of us. Now, they’re turning Flag Day into a celebration of Trump.
💰 He’s using OUR tax dollars to pay for HIS party: Donald Trump’s birthday celebration is expected to cost millions of our tax dollars, all while Republicans claim there’s no money for Social Security, SNAP, or Medicaid.
👑 We are united against kings: Trump has already indicated that he’s aiming for at least a third term, and now he’s planning a self-aggrandizing military parade in D.C But the American people don’t put up with kings. Together, we will mobilize in huge numbers to reject this corruption and abuse of power—it’s in our DNA as a country.
✋ They’ve gone too far: This is bigger than political disagreement. They’ve defied our courts, deported American citizens, disappeared people off the streets, and slashed our services—all while orchestrating a massive giveaway to their billionaire allies. Enough is enough. For anyone who thinks he’s gone too far, this movement is for you.
We’re standing together against the abuses of power, cruelty, and corruption.
When clowns 🤡 are elected, expect a circus 🎪 -
America 🇺🇸 has No King! 👑

title: Honk & Wave: Tell Avelo Airlines to Change Course

address_lines: near the intersection of Rt. 13 and School Lane

description:
Hosted by Indivisible Highlands and Beyond (IHB). Co-hosted by 302 United and Indivisible Newark First State.

Avelo Airlines signed a contract with ICE to begin illegal "deportation" (aka kidnapping) flights from AZ beginning on May 12. The US Government has detained and deported people without due process or legal justification. 

Indivisible Highlands and Beyond, 302 United, and Indivisible Newark First State demand that Avelo Airlines changes course immediately!! Come out and help us keep up the pressure!

This rally will be one of dozen's around the country on May 31st to pressure Avelo to cancel its ICE contract.

Bring signs! We will have some to share, but we urge you to continue making your own great/creative signs! (Given often fast-moving traffic, a reminder about signs: 
Keep the message simple;
use large letters;
and make the letters thick and bold.)

We'll rally on both sides of Rt. 13, so stay on whichever side of the highway you park on. Please do NOT cross the busy highway!

After the Honk & Wave, all are welcome to gather at the IHOP across the street for "Protest and Pancakes!" (You don't have to get pancakes; they have avocado toast and veggie sausage, too!) Join us to connect and converse!!

Parking Options:

Go to Lot D, $7.00 per car, then walk to the nearby sidewalk along the DuPont Hwy. (The first section of Lot D is a quick right turn after passing the ChristianaCare-GoHealth Urgent Care, right next to the Wilmington Airport.The second section of Lot D is a right turn immediately after you past this first turn for lot D.  There is a sign for Lot D at this turn.)

You can create an account online ahead of time so you can complete your payment from home in advance.  We recommend taking this step ahead of time, so you can just park and join us. Go to this link to set up your parking account: https://p-123.com/. Click on the ‘create your account now’ button. You will be asked for the zone ID which is 10500. You will add your license plate number, then pay with a credit card. 
You could also use this same link or a QR code once you arrive to pay.  The signs in the parking lot have this info.
At this link below you can see where Lot D (or Remote lot) is located:
https://www.flyilg.com/parking-wilmington-airport-ilg

Parking is also available behind the IHOP across the street: specifically, try the large shopping area lot between IHOP and Planet Fitness. (Again, if you park there, stay on that side of the road to rally along DuPont Hwy in front of the IHOP. Do NOT cross DuPont Hwy.)

This a local Indivisible event!

While some in DC are hosting a massive, wildly expensive, taxpayer-funded display of US military might in DC to humor the ego of an aspiring authoritarian, here in the Waterville, Maine, area Indivisible Mid Maine will host a non-violent march and rally to celebrate and communicate the values and joys of the compassionate, sustainable, just community, country, and world we are striving to build. Join us!

This non-violent community event will consist of a march AND a rally. Participants are welcome to join us for any portion of the event. If you want to and are able to march, join us at 10 am at the town office in Fairfield, Maine, (19 Lawrence Ave.) with upbeat signs you can carry. At the Fairfield Town Office we will hear a very brief statement, reminding us all of the civil and human rights and values that are enshrined in both the Maine and US Constitutions and which we urge our leaders to uphold.

Marchers will then head down Lawrence Ave. to Main St., turn right and march along Main Street till it becomes College Ave. and then march along College Ave. until it becomes Main St., in Waterville, all the way to Waterville City Hall (1 Common St.). There the same brief statement that was delivered at the Fairfield Town Office will be repeated. We expect to arrive at City Hall around 11:30.

The distance of the march is about 3.4 miles, flat and with sidewalks all or most of the way. Participants should feel free to participate in any portion of the march, or the whole thing. Folks who want to travel the route by car or other vehicle are welcome to do so while we are marching, and may want to decorate their vehicles with signs similar to those that the marchers will be carrying.

After the march, participants will gather at a nearby location (TBD!) where the associated rally will begin at 11:30 and run until about 1pm, with music, light snacks, opportunities to meet and talk with others who share our non-violent, pro-democracy, pro-justice and human rights values, and to make and display relevant signs, etc.

Our goal is to continue building community here where we live, even as we engage in resistance against the larger forces that seek to destroy everything we hold dear. Please join us for all or part of this fun and uplifting event. If you can help with any of the pieces of the event, please reach out. And please watch this space for updates!

title: 12 Days to Democracy! JOIN THE MARCH - June 16 to 28

location.venue: Dilworth Park, City Hall, Philadelphia, PA

description:
This is it. This is the action.

Democracy has always been about the power of the people. It’s we, the people, who will fight the fight for a more just and equitable society.

This is the work– not of kings– but by all of us and for all of us. We’re the ones who have to travel the distance. 

And this is why, at this critical juncture in our history - when the laws and institutions protecting our right to fight are under attack like never before -  we have decided to take a very long walk.

Our walk – a 120-mile journey from Philly to DC - will take us through towns, into cities, and along the trails of the East Coast Greenway, and we hope that it will look like the world we want to see: friendly and civil. Open to the joys of human variation, the friendliness of flexible minds, and also street dancing. This is a big, long mission; a walk/march, inspired by the big, hopeful, goodness-based, law-governed dream that is American democracy. We hope you’ll consider joining us - for a mile, a city limit, the whole journey. 

BRASS TACKS: We are still hammering out the route, and you can see where we are below.  Days 1,2,3 are solid, and the rest are nearly solid (5/9).  We are seeking to obtain discounted hotel rates as well as tent options. The plan for hotels is to book a set block for the whole route which we will offer in one sum, and to have group discount codes for these hotels for people booking a subset of the nights.  Please reach out if you have more questions. This event will put you on our mailing list to be updated as soon as this information becomes available. 

FOR MORE DETAILS VISIT OUR WEBSITE: https://www.democracy12.com/

description:
It's time to raise our voices and make our presence known to bring attention to the future of our beloved Veterans, their rights, their jobs and their future. We will be holding a rally/protest at the DELRAY BEACH VA CLINIC on Friday June 6th from 10AM - 12PM. We want to thank the employees who are still providing life saving services at the VA and protest the disgraceful cuts that continue to be made to the Veterans Administration. Our action is being done in cooperation with the National 

JOSH WEIL who ran in Florida's District 6 Congressional Race this past April will join us and provide a rally to help us mobilize, motivate and continue to engage our movement. If you haven't heard Josh speak, you are in for a treat. He is incredibly articulate, passionate and committed to saving our democracy. He is the REAL THING!

UNITE FOR VETERANS RALLY in Washington, DC.
Veterans are planning a massive rally in Washington, D.C., and elsewhere June 6 to protest cuts at the Department of Veterans Affairs and call for the protection of veterans' benefits and jobs, which are being hurt by the Trump administration's efforts to reduce the size of the federal government. The Unite for Veterans, Unite for America rally, is scheduled for the 81st anniversary of D-Day and is a call to preserve veterans' jobs and benefits and promote the protection of democratic principles.

We are so excited to join together for a No Kings Protest in Coral Springs! Please continue to spread the word and bring friends with you. There are over 1000 events planned nationwide!

Plenty of water
A lawn chair if standing will be difficult
Can’t wait to see you!

In solidarity, Christine

description:
## Time to Rain on This Wannabe King’s Parade
June 14 is Flag Day and Trump’s birthday—and he’s throwing himself a $45 million military-style birthday bash. With our tax dollars. We say: NO KINGS. YES TO THE PEOPLE.

Join in this **county-wide #NoKings takeover** with 20+ pop-up protests all across Marin. One loud, visible, united stand against Trump’s grift and power grab.

- Cut a **heart-shaped sign** from poster board (a good size is around 18x24" or larger)
- Write: **“NO KINGS, YES _______”** (Fill in the blank with what you believe in— like democracy, healthcare, education, social security, the law, the people, etc.)

Get bold and creative. This country needs more love for people—not billionaires.

👑 Marin doesn’t kneel.

💖 We rise together.

Bring friends. Show up big on **June 14**. 

Sponsored by Indivisible Marin.

_A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. title: NO KINGS South Bay LA
description:
June 14, 1775 marked the birth of the U.S. Army—a force created to stand against tyranny and unchecked power. Now, 250 years later, that legacy is being distorted. President Donald Trump plans to commemorate the Army’s anniversary with a taxpayer-funded military parade in Washington, D.C.—on his own birthday. This **$45 million spectacle** isn’t just about the military; it’s about glorifying one man.

Trump has made flirtatious comments about seeking a third term, hinting at constitutional workarounds, though he officially claims he’ll be a two-term president. Regardless, the ambition is clear—and dangerous. This isn’t how democracies are supposed to work. **On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings.** NO KINGS is a National Day of Action and mass mobilization. Check out nokings.org for more information.

His administration continues to dismantle democratic norms:

- Immigration authorities have fast-tracked deportations, in some cases defying due process protections and alarming rights groups

- Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has launched an unfounded investigation into autism’s causes, reviving debunked theories linking it to vaccines—causing distress among scientists and disability advocates

- Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility (DEIA) programs are under attack. For example, the NIH has withheld medical research funding for universities if they do not dismantle their DEIA initiatives.

- Institutions like Columbia University and Harvard have faced federal funding cuts and pressure to suppress campus protests, raising serious concerns about free speech and academic freedom.

- Trump’s proposed budget slashes education, Medicare, and Medicaid—gutting essential services while greenlighting a vanity parade.

**South Bay LA** stands for truth over theatrics. Every peaceful protest is a defense of democracy and dignity. If you believe Trump has gone too far, this movement is for you. Join the South Bay community's rebuttal to Trump's show of undesired authoritarian power. Show that American pride is rooted in diversity, equity, inclusion—and the fundamental belief that people with disabilities are not broken, but that there is ability in every disability.

🚨**On Saturday, June 14th we are rallying at Torrance City Hall with a clear message: One Nation, Indivisible with Truth and Justice for All.  #NoKings** 🚨

title: Kings & Clowns Rally

address_lines: South Oneida Avenue & East Kemp Street

description:
When a Clown moves into a Palace, he doesn’t become a King, the Palace becomes a Circus. While the clown throws himself a birthday party in Washington, the people in the Northwoods are defending our democracy!


WHAT IS “NO KINGS! NO CLOWNS!? It is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to the increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption of the Trump administration. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political positions, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies. They think they rule—but we are bigger than even their worst aspirations.
Donald Trump is planning a military parade in Washington, D.C. on June 14. This display of might is intended to intimidate opponents and solidify his image as a strongman on our dime—we won’t stand by and watch!
Donald Trump thinks his rule is absolute, but in America, we don’t do “kings.” Since the inauguration, the Trump administration and its enablers have operated as though they have a mandate—but they don’t, and never did. They are going to extremes to empower Trump and enrich themselves, while cutting jobs and services for the rest of us. Now, they’re turning Flag Day into a celebration of Trump.
💰 He’s using OUR tax dollars to pay for HIS party: Donald Trump’s birthday celebration is expected to cost millions of our tax dollars, all while Republicans claim there’s no money for Social Security, SNAP, or Medicaid.
👑 We are united against kings: Trump has already indicated that he’s aiming for at least a third term, and now he’s planning a self-aggrandizing military parade in D.C But the American people don’t put up with kings. Together, we will mobilize in huge numbers to reject this corruption and abuse of power—it’s in our DNA as a country.
✋ They’ve gone too far: This is bigger than political disagreement. They’ve defied our courts, deported American citizens, disappeared people off the streets, and slashed our services—all while orchestrating a massive giveaway to their billionaire allies. Enough is enough. For anyone who thinks he’s gone too far, this movement is for you.
We’re standing together against the abuses of power, cruelty, and corruption. On June 14, we gather to remind Trump and his enablers: America has No King!

description:

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

**In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.**
NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.


🚨**On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets nationwide. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.**🚨


The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.


**On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings.**
Check out (nokings.org) for more information.

* **He’s using OUR tax dollars to pay for HIS party.** Donald Trump’s birthday celebration is expected to cost millions of our tax dollars, all while Republicans claim there’s no money for Social Security, SNAP, or Medicaid.


* **We are united against kings.** Trump has already indicated that he’s aiming for at least a third term, and now he’s planning a self-aggrandizing military parade in D.C. *But the American people don’t put up with kings.* Together, we will mobilize in huge numbers to reject this corruption and abuse of power—*it’s in our DNA as a country.*

* **They've gone too far.** This is bigger than political disagreement. They’ve defied our courts, deported American citizens, disappeared people off the streets, and slashed our services—all while orchestrating a massive giveaway to their billionaire allies. *Enough is enough.* For anyone who thinks he’s gone too far, this movement is for you.

* **The Army’s birthday isn’t about parades or pageantry — it marks the beginning of America’s rejection of kings.** On June 14, 1775, the Continental Congress created the U.S. Army to stand up against a monarch who claimed absolute power. 250 years later, Donald Trump wants to twist that legacy into a personal celebration of himself.

* **That’s why we say: No Thrones. No Crowns. No Kings.** No Kings is about defending the ideals they fought for. This country doesn’t belong to strongmen. It belongs to the people.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

As with every protest, we want to highlight the extreme unconstitutional practices of this administration, as this is not just about policies. 

This is NOT business as usual in DC, this is NOT normal. 

This republican administration has attempted to seize control over state election processes through executive orders and efforts to undermine civil rights legislation, as well as threatening the checks and balances established by the Constitution, such as disregarding court orders and altering federal regulations without proper authority.​​ The administration is using its current power to help billionaires continue to profit while striping away the services that help the most needy. 

We need to stand up for due process, free speech, upholding court rulings, and the separation of church and state. title: 100% Clean Energy Rally

sponsor.name: New Jersey League of Conservation Voters

description:
Governor Murphy has committed to a 100% clean energy future by 2035 through executive order. But unless this goal is passed by legislation, it could be delayed or eliminated entirely. 

Because the federal administration is moving full speed towards a grid powered by dirty energy, it is up to states to take action on climate change while we still can. And for this bill, we are running out of time. 

Join New Jersey LCV and Sierra Club New Jersey at 9am on June 12th for a rally at the front steps of the Trenton State House Annex Building front steps to urge our leaders to pass this crucial legislation. Following this rally and media moment, join us for a day of action lobbying your own legislators - now is the time to make your voice heard. 

Sign up for more details.

title: This is Your City Rally

location.venue: El Centro de la Raza, Plaza Roberto Maestas

description:
If you have not yet signed up for an Onboarding Zoom Call, it's a great way to meet Katie, find out her platform, and find out what our campaign is going to look like. Sign up for one here: https://www.mobilize.us/wilsonforseattle/event/770491/


This is your city. 

We’re less than three months away from the August primary. I’ve run a lot of campaigns over the years, and I know how important it is to set ambitious but achievable goals. So I’m calling it now. Here’s what we’re going to do, together:

We’re going to be in first place on August 5th.

That’s right, you heard it. We’re not just going to make it through the primary. We’re going to win more votes than Bruce Harrell.

We can absolutely do this. But it’s not going to happen automatically, and it’s not going to be easy. That said, there is one easy thing you can do right now to help us achieve this goal:

RSVP for the This Is Your City Rally coming up on Saturday, May 31st.

This rally will kick off an intense, all-hands-on-deck, ten-week stretch of bringing our message to voters — especially infrequent and new voters — across Seattle. Because THAT is how we’re going to win first place in the primary: by talking face-to-face with tens of thousands of people who aren’t going to vote this year unless we reach them.

Needless to say, I’m going to need your help, whether that’s knocking on doors, phonebanking, talking to people at festivals and light rail stations, writing letters to fellow tenants in your apartment building, or texting your friends and family. You can do a lot of that right now, of course — but we’re all going to have to turn it up a notch in the final stretch.

But beyond all that, here are three reasons why I’m really hoping to see you on May 31st:

To show our strength. Our rally will send a clear message to all the people who still think Harrell has this race locked down. At our March kickoff, 150 people came together to launch this campaign. Let’s demonstrate how much our numbers have grown!

To build for the long haul. I know we can win this race, but it’s about much more than getting one person elected. When I’m in City Hall, it’s not like the entrenched interests that are fighting us on the campaign trail are going to give up and say “How can we help?” They’re going to keep fighting us. They’re going to try to make sure I’m not able to do any of the good things we want to see happen for Seattle, and they’re going to try to turn the public against us. We’re going to need a powerful movement of people on the outside, organizing and building power, so we can make progress. Building that movement starts now.

Oh yeah, and it’s going to be fun! Great company, good food, rousing speeches (but not too many), and meaningful action. I’m not saying there will be cornhole, but I’m also not saying there won’t be. What better way to spend a couple hours on your Saturday? 

Location and time are TBD, but it will be transit accessible. It will help us plan if you RSVP now!
